newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Yemen lifts second quarter crude price - MEES.
newsitem.headline: Yemen lifts second quarter crude price - MEES.

text.p: Yemen has increased its second quarter term crude prices by 15-47 cents a barrel, the Middle East Economic Survey (MEES) reported on Monday.
Marib Light was increased to dated Brent minus 15 cents a barrel, compared to dated minus 30 cents in the first quarter, and Masila to dated Brent minus 50 cents from minus 97 cents.

Second quarter term lifters of Marib Light are Arcadia (15,000 barrels per day), Mitsui (5,000 bpd) Japan Energy (5,000 bpd), British Petroleum Plc (5,000 bpd), Vitol (5,000 bpd) and Dubai's Emirates National Oil Company (5,000 bpd), MEES reported.

Masila contracts are with Arcadia (15,000 bpd), Mitsui (10,000 bpd), British Petroleum (10,000 bpd), Yukong (10,000 bpd), Statoil (10,000 bpd), Sinochem (7,000 bpd), Kanematsu (5,000 bpd), Japan Energy (5,000 bpd), Chevron (5,000 bpd), Glencore (5,000 bpd), Phibro (5,000 bpd) and Vitol (5,000 bpd).
